responses: Hello! Welcome to the University Student Support Desk. How can I assist you today? You can ask about admissions, tuition fees, course registration, exams, hostel, library, or support tickets.
Hi there! I'm your AI Student Support Assistant. Ask me anything about academics, campus facilities, scholarships, exam schedules, or raise a support ticket!

intents.description: Admission requirements, deadlines, application process, and eligibility
patterns: documents needed required for undergraduate admission
responses:
Admissions are open online through the University Admissions Portal.
• Application Window: March 1 – July 15 (Fall Intake) & October 1 – November 30 (Spring Intake)
• Eligibility: Minimum 60% aggregate in qualifying examinations (55% for reserved categories) + valid Entrance Test score.
• Required Documents: Transcripts, Transfer Certificate, ID Proof, Passport Photos, and Category Certificate (if applicable).
• Tip: Share a program name (e.g., 'B.Tech', 'MBA', 'B.Sc', 'MCA') to view program-specific tuition and eligibility details!

intents.description: Tuition fees, payment deadlines, installment plans, and scholarships
patterns: how much is the tuition fee
apply for a scholarship and scholarship criteria
responses:
Here is the overview of Tuition Fees & Financial Aid:
• Payment Modes: Online via Student ERP Portal (NetBanking, UPI, Credit/Debit Card, or Demand Draft).
• Due Dates: August 10 (Odd Semester) and January 10 (Even Semester). Late fee is ₹500/week after the deadline.
• Scholarships Available:
  1. Merit Scholarship: 50% tuition waiver for CGPA >= 9.0 or top 5% entrance rank.
  2. Need-Based Financial Aid: Up to 75% tuition support for family income below ₹3,00,000/year.
  3. Sports & Cultural Excellence Scholarship: 25%–100% fee waiver.
• Mention a specific program (e.g., 'B.Tech', 'MBA', 'MCA', 'B.Sc') to get the exact semester-wise fee breakdown.

intents.description: Adding/dropping courses, credit limits, electives, and academic registration
patterns: add or drop a course subject
credits can i register for this semester
responses:
Course Registration Guidelines:
• Registration Window: Opens 2 weeks prior to each semester on the Student Academic ERP.
• Credit Limits: Minimum 16 credits, Maximum 24 credits per regular semester (up to 28 with Dean's approval for CGPA >= 8.5).
• Add/Drop Period: First 10 working days of the semester with zero penalty.
• Course Withdrawal ('W' Grade): Allowed up to Week 8 of the semester.
• If you mention a course code (such as CS101, CS204, CS305, MA102, MB301, EC202), I can look up its credits, instructor, and exam schedule!

intents.description: Exam schedules, hall tickets, grading system, CGPA calculation, and revaluation
patterns: download admit card or hall ticket
apply for paper revaluation or rechecking
when will semester results be declared
exam date and instructor for cs101 cs305
responses:
Examinations & Evaluation Policy:
• Weightage: Continuous Internal Assessment (40%: Quizzes 10%, Assignments 10%, Mid-Term 20%) + End-Semester Exam (60%).
• Attendance Requirement: Minimum 75% attendance is mandatory to download the Hall Ticket (condonation up to 65% strictly on medical grounds).
• 10-Point Grading Scale: O (10), A+ (9), A (8), B+ (7), B (6), C (5), P (4), F (0 - Fail).
• Revaluation: Apply within 7 days of result declaration via ERP (₹300 per course).
• Tip: Ask with a course code like 'Exam schedule for CS101' or 'Details for MA102' for exact dates and venues!

intents.description: Library timings, book borrowing limits, overdue fines, and digital library access
patterns: books can i borrow from the library
access ieee and springer digital library
responses:
Central Library & Digital Resource Center:
• Operating Hours: Mon–Sat 8:00 AM – 10:00 PM | Sundays & Holidays 9:00 AM – 5:00 PM (24x7 Reading Hall open during exams).
• Borrowing Privileges: UG Students: 4 books for 14 days | PG Students: 6 books for 21 days | Research Scholars: 8 books for 30 days.
• Overdue Fine: ₹5 per day per book for the first 14 days, ₹10 per day thereafter.
• Digital Library: Remote access to IEEE Xplore, SpringerLink, ACM Digital Library, and NPTEL via your institutional email on the Knimbus/EZproxy portal.

intents.description: Hostel accommodation, mess timings, Wi-Fi, medical center, and transport
patterns: hostel charges fee and mess charges
responses:
Hostel, Dining & Campus Facilities:
• Hostel Allocation: Allotted on a first-come, distance-priority basis via the HMS Portal. Options: Single, Double, and Triple occupancy (AC & Non-AC).
• Hostel & Mess Charges: Non-AC Double: ₹45,000/sem | AC Double: ₹62,000/sem | Mess Plan: ₹24,000/sem (includes breakfast, lunch, evening snacks, and dinner).
• Gate Timings: Main campus entry open until 10:30 PM; late academic lab passes available via Faculty Advisor.
• 24x7 Campus Health Center: Located in Block D (Emergency Helpline: +91-121-2550108).

intents.description: Student ERP password reset, campus Wi-Fi, institutional email, and LMS issues
patterns: forgot my student erp login password
campus wifi is not working connecting
software license for matlab and office 365
responses:
IT Helpdesk & Digital Services:
• Password Reset: Click 'Forgot Password' on the ERP login page to receive an OTP on your registered mobile, or email ithelpdesk@university.edu.
• Campus Wi-Fi ('UniNet-5G'): Log in using your Student ID (e.g., STU2026001) and ERP password. Register up to 3 device MAC addresses.
• Free Software Suite: Active students receive Microsoft 365, GitHub Student Developer Pack, MATLAB Campus-Wide License, and AutoCAD Education free with their @university.edu email.

intents.description: Internships, campus placements, resume reviews, and training cell
patterns: when does campus placement season start
get an internship noc from the placement cell
responses:
Training, Internships & Career Placement Cell (T&P):
• Placement Registration: Opens in 6th Semester (UG) / 2nd Semester (PG) on the Superset/T&P Portal.
• Internship NOC & Bonafide: Generate automatically under 'ERP -> Student Services -> Certificates & NOC' within 24 hours.
• Career Prep Services: Weekly mock technical interviews, aptitude bootcamps, and 1-on-1 resume clinics every Wednesday & Friday (2:00 PM – 5:00 PM, Placement Block Room 204).

intents.description: Student counseling, stress management, mentorship, and anti-ragging support
patterns: feeling stressed about exams book counseling
mental health and student wellness center
responses:
Student Wellness, Counseling & Grievance Support:
• Confidential Counseling: Free, strictly confidential 1-on-1 sessions with certified counselors at the Wellness Center (Block B, Ground Floor, Mon–Fri 9:00 AM – 6:00 PM).
• 24x7 Student Support Helpline: +91-121-2550999 | Email: wellness@university.edu
• Anti-Ragging & Grievance Cell: 24x7 Toll-Free Helpline 1800-180-5522 or submit an anonymous report via the ERP Grievance tab.

Happy to help! Good luck with your studies, and have a wonderful day on campus!
